newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy seen issuing 10 trln lire BTP/CCTs.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy seen issuing 10 trln lire BTP/CCTs.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is expected to issue on average 10.0 trillion lire of fixed-rate government bonds (BTP) and floating-rate certificates (CCT) at its mid-month auction, analysts polled by Reuters said.
Estimates ranged from 8.0 to 11.5 trillion lire worth of paper to be offered at the March 13 and 14 auctions.
Only 2.85 trillion lire worth of CCTs mature this month, on March 24, and only a handful of coupons fall due.

The Treasury has announced that on March 13 it will offer a first tranche of March 1, 2004 CCT, with a 3.55 percent coupon, a 7th tranche of February 1, 2007 BTP, with a 6.75 percent coupon, and a 5th tranche of 7.25 percent November 1, 2026 BTP.
On March 14, it will offer a 5th tranche of February 5, 2000 BTP, with a 6.0 percent coupon, and a third tranche of March 1, 2002 BTP, with a 6.25 percent coupon.
The Treasury will detail the amounts of paper on offer on March 10.
